spec.description: Métricas en tiempo real para sistema Face Recognition y Deteccion de Imagens, Materia Sistemas en Tiempo Real, IUA 2026.

spec.query: SELECT MEAN("mean") FROM /.*latency.*/ WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval)
SELECT mean("usage") FROM "docker_container_mem" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "container_name", time($__interval) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") as "Incomming Request" FROM /^api_.*_throughput_incoming$/ WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") as "Successful requests" FROM /^api_.*_throughput_success$/ WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(0)
SELECT sum("value") FROM /^api_.*_errors_.*/ WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY *

spec.title: Tiempo de procesamiento promedio por inferencia (yolo)

spec.query: SELECT mean("mean") FROM /^worker_.*_yolo_inference_time$/ WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

spec.title: Tiempo promedio de generacion de embeddings

spec.query: SELECT mean("mean") FROM /^worker_.*_recognition_embedding_time$/ WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT mean("mean") FROM /^worker_.*_recognition_comparison_time$/ WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT sum("value") FROM /^api_.*_endpoint_.*_queries$/ WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), * fill(0)

spec.title: Cantidad de peticiones por instancia de API

spec.query: SELECT sum("value") FROM /^api_.*_throughput_incoming$/ WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval),* fill(0)

spec.title: Porcentaje de imagenes en las que no se detecto nada

spec.query: SELECT mean("usage_percent") FROM "docker_container_cpu" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "container_name", time($__interval) fill(0)

spec.title: SOA Face Recognition
